instructions: Template only; no observation has been supplied.
Use the exact private forecast scope for the place actually observed; do not reuse current-location aliases after moving.
Use ISO timestamps with explicit +07:00 or UTC.
continuous_interval: an actually observed complete aligned hour; raining means any rain during that hour; not_raining means dry throughout the hour.
point_check: coverage_start equals coverage_end, retained but excluded from hourly scores.
not_observed is missing coverage, never dry.
Do not estimate millimeters without a gauge; this adapter accepts rain state only.
Set template_only=false only for an actual report. Keep filled files outside git.
